summary: Satya, co-host of the podcast Melanin Millennials, publicly addressed the sudden removal from the show by Shout Out Network (SON), revealing that SON acquired the show's trademark without consent and replaced her as co-host in late August 2017. She detailed how she worked alongside M.R.A.L. Morgan and Effie to build the platform since 2015, emphasizing her belief that the content belonged to her and her team despite lacking formal contracts at the time. Satya expressed deep regret over the lack of transparency and agency, stating her intention to reclaim ownership of the content she created while thanking the community for their support.
